entry.name: Ivysaur-H
entry.flavor: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.
entry.flavorEs: La luz del sol lo fortalece y hace que le crezca el capullo que tiene en el lomo.
entry.flavorZh: 沐浴在阳光下越久， 身体内会涌出越多力量， 背上的花苞也会渐渐成长。

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Grass attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Planta infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其草属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Planta infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
abilities.textEs: Sube su Velocidad cuando hace sol.
abilities.detail: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
abilities.detailEs: La Velocidad de este Pokémon se duplica durante el sol intenso. Esta bonificación no cuenta como un cambio de estadística.
abilities.detailZh: 日照强烈时，该宝可梦的速度变为2倍。该加成不计为能力等级变化。
abilities.detailPt: A Velocidade deste Pokémon é dobrada durante sol forte. Este bônus não conta como modificador de estágio.
